title: Good app but missing one feature
body: My experience with this app have been ruined by the fact that you can’t customise your schedule. It would have been amazing if you could type down your own time like example 8:15 and then 9:20 but instead the app just lets you pick if you want all time in quarters or half’s which is bad
author: Alfazozo8438

title: Exactly what I wanted
body: TimeFinder is a great time blocking app w/ to do list features (v satisfying) & it’s nice that it is not a subscription service!
author: Snaleks
